problem_statement: Return the length of the longest consecutive run of identical elements in values. A run is a maximal sequence of consecutive equal elements. values is any Python list of integers (excluding bool), including an empty list. For an empty list return 0. Do not modify the input.
valid_input_domain: Return the length of the longest consecutive run of identical elements in values. A run is a maximal sequence of consecutive equal elements. values is any Python list of integers (excluding bool), including an empty list. For an empty list return 0. Do not modify the input.
bug_explanation: The faulty solution omits the else branch that resets current to 1, so the running count never resets between different runs.
